items.title: Reproduce the false positive as a failing fixture, then narrow the pairing rule so ordinary priority prose passes while real triage-authority text is still caught
items.context: RED: a fixture feeding the B-1482 CHK-003 sentence through classifyControlledTriageRelations expects no violation and fails today; a second fixture with genuine severity-as-authority text (for example a context that tells a reviewer that high severity alone decides who owns a finding) must still be caught. GREEN: require a grammatical relation rather than 260-character co-occurrence, or narrow the term lists. Both fixtures committed.
